newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chungtex Electronic sets US$25 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Chungtex Electronic sets US$25 mln FRN.

text.p: Chungtex Electronic Co's US$25 million floating rate note issue has been launched into general syndication, bankers said on Thursday.
They said the facility has a final maturity of three years with annual put options. The issue was priced at par to float at 70 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 7.5 basis points for lead managers committing US$5 million, five basis points for managers committing US$3-5 million, 3.5 basis points for co-managers committing US$2-3 million.
Citicorp International is the mandated arranger.
